description: This file defines a custom exception class `SassScriptException` within the `ScssPhp\ScssPhp\Exception` namespace, intended for handling exceptions related to SassScript processing in the SCSS PHP compiler. The class provides a static method to create exceptions with contextual argument names.

classes.name: SassScriptException
classes.description: A custom exception class for SassScript errors, extending the base PHP Exception class, with a static method to facilitate creation with argument context.

methods.name: forArgument
methods.description: A static helper method to create a SassScriptException that includes the argument name in the error message, improving error reporting related to specific argument issues.
